playstyle.identity: Urgot is a juggernaut with shotgun knees who executes low-health enemies. He excels at extended trades and can pull enemies into his meat grinder.
playstyle.howToPlay: Passive: shotgun knees fire on autos, rotating around him (each knee has CD). Q slows in an area. W toggles rapid fire at reduced damage. E dashes and flips first enemy hit. R fires a drill that slows - at low HP, recast to execute and fear nearby enemies.
playstyle.powerSpikes: Urgot spikes at level 9 with max W and at 6 with execute. Black Cleaver stacks fast with W. He's strong in extended fights.

passive.name: Echoing Flames
passive.summary: Auto attacks near enemies trigger shotgun knees dealing percent health damage.
passive.details: Urgot's six legs each have a shotgun that fires when he auto attacks in that direction, dealing percent max health damage. Each knee has a separate cooldown.

abilities.name: Corrosive Charge
abilities.summary: Fire a bomb that slows enemies in an area.
abilities.details: Urgot fires a canister that explodes at a location, dealing damage and slowing enemies.

abilities.name: Purge
abilities.summary: Toggle rapid fire at reduced damage; shields when maxed.
abilities.details: Urgot toggles rapid auto attacks at reduced damage. Attacks automatically target lowest health enemy. At max rank, has no mana cost and shields Urgot.

abilities.name: Disdain
abilities.summary: Dash and flip the first enemy hit.
abilities.details: Urgot charges forward, shielding himself. The first enemy hit is stunned and flipped behind him.

abilities.name: Fear Beyond Death
abilities.summary: Fire a drill; at low HP, recast to execute and fear enemies.
abilities.details: Urgot fires a drill that impales the first champion hit, slowing them. If the target drops below 25% HP, recast to reel them in and execute them, fearing nearby enemies.
